name: Ryoujoku Spiral
original_name: リョウジョクスパイラル
source:
The message came over SNS. Natsumi was deceived
and assailed by dirty old men. They uploaded her violation
online, along with similarly victimized friend Yumi.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ100815.html?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
